sourceSentences: Heimerdinger gains bonus movement speed while near an allied turret or a H-28G Evolution Turret or H-28Q Apex Turret deployed by him.
Up to 3 H-28G Evolution Turrets can be deployed at a time, with those deployed beyond the maximum destroying the oldest one.

Every rocket hitting an enemy champion grants 20% beam charge to all H-28G Evolution Turret H-28Q Apex Turret within 1000 range, up to a maximum of 100% beam charge when hitting 5 rockets on an enemy champion.
Hextech Micro-Rockets' direction-targeting allows for custom spread.
Total range is 1350, starting from 200 units behind Heimerdinger
If the grenade hits an enemy champion, all H-28G Evolution Turret H-28Q Apex Turret within 1000 range of the impact gain 100% beam charge.
Enemies hit at the center of the grenade's impact are also stunned for 1.5 seconds.
UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Heimerdinger hurls a massive grenade at the target location that bounces a fixed distance 3 times in the cast direction.
Heimerdinger deploys a H-28Q Apex Turret at the target location, which lasts for 8 seconds.
For combos, if anyone walks into your towers, attack into E followed by an attack into W for tons of damage.
And if you're not set up, use your ultimate Q into Q and E. Place another turret down with Q into your W before placing your final turret down and spamming away with attacks.
So, if he lands all five on an enemy champion, the turrets automatically shoot their beam attack.
Enemies hit by the center are stunned instead and when this hits an enemy champion, it automatically charges all nearby turrets and they shoot their beam attack.
Heimer's passive is he gains bonus move speed when near an allied turret or one of his own turrets.
Replace any turrets that go down and focus on landing W and E to charge the beams.
The rockets converge on the cursor so if we aim directly at the target, the rockets can be easily dodged.
If we want to hit all 5 rockets, we want to put our cursor in front of the enemy champion model.
We can consider bringing our cursor closer to us so that we can create a larger fan shape when necessary.
If the enemy is just on top of us then we can just throw the grenade exactly where they are.
This is because Heimerdinger shoots his rockets from the back of his head so we have to keep this in mind. Try not to W with minions behind us.
Enemies will often avoid going near our turrets. If we don't put down all our turrets, they will let their guard down and then we can throw them the E-Q combo.
If we want to, we can also take this further by doing E-Q-W-Q or E-Q-R-W-Q.
R-E is the best combo to use if we want to secure a kill because the upgraded grenade is hard to dodge. We can take this combo further by doing R-E-Q-W.
